item.name: 3 Colors Motion Sensor LED Light Ultra-Thin Smart Wireless Cabinet Lights TYPE-C Wardrobe Lamp Rechargeable
item.title: 3 Colors Motion Sensor LED Light Ultra-Thin Smart Wireless Cabinet Lights TYPE-C Wardrobe Lamp Rechargeable
item.description:
Features
-1.1cm ultra-thin design, thin and delicate, inconspicuous embellishment.
-Motion Sensor Feature. Walk in & Auto Light Up. Lights will be auto turn on by motion activated within 3-5m/120° in the dark or in the dimmer surroundings, then auto turn off after 25 seconds to save battery life.
-Built-in Rechargeable Battery. No AAA Batteries: This motion sensor light is powered by a large capacity rechargeable battery which can last few weeks or even months (Only when works in motion sensor mode, e.g auto light up within 10 times per day).But frequent auto light up might decrease battery life.
-Lighting(Color Temperature: 3000-6000K):Three colors can be switched independently. Extra Long LED life: >20000 Hours.
-Cordless & Magnetic Feature: Due to this magnetic feature, It can be hand-held lighting or can also be easy absorbed on any iron furniture, such as the outside of the refrigerator, iron shelves or safes. Easy recharged by any USB Charger. Tips: USB Charging Cable is included, but charger is not included in the package.
-Wide range of applications: Perfect for portable lighting applications that don't have a power source like closet, under cabinet, counter, shelf, hallway, wardrobe, kit

MODE:
Mode1: Motion Sensor Mode
Mode2: Always On Mode
Mode3: OFF

Charging :
LED Closet Light with a built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery, it only needs 3 hours to charge quickly, It can last for over 5 Hours under Always On Mode, if lighted eight times a day, it can last for about three months.

Package includes:
1 * Cabinet light
1 * 3M double-sided adhesive tape
1 * USB cable
1 * Instructions

Description:
Item type: Motion Sensor Light
Size: About 235*40*9mm / 405*40*9mm / 605*40*9mm
Product weight: 110g/ 195/ 275g
Light color:3000K,4000K,6000K
Induction method: Human body induction
Induction distance: 3-5 meters
Delay time: 20 seconds
Protection level: IP42
Battery capacity:300mah /900mah /1500mah
Power : 1.4W/2.4.0W/3.2W
Lumen: 90 /170 /230Lm/W
Shell material: aluminium +PC
Work time:5h/7h/7h
Lithium battery life:500 times Charge- Discharge
Use range: Wardrobe, cabinet, corridor, dark compartment, shoe cabinet, etc.
Charging indicator status: When charging, the indicator light is red, fully charged, and the indicator light will turn blue.

Notes:

1-2cm error might exist due to manual measurements, please kindly understand. The colors deviation might differ due to different monitor settings.

We provide you with the best product and service. If you have any problem, please let us know, and we will solve the problem ASAP. Thank you so much
Adjust light color: Set switch to ON, short press the button.

Adjust brightness: Set switch to ON, long press the button.

Switch sensing modes: Set switch to AUTO. Single click for night sensing; double click for day sensing.

Use remote control: Set switch to AUTO. One remote can control unlimited lights.

Charging notice: Use adapter below 10W. Do NOT use dual Type‑C cable.
